presentation.name: Write a dashboard FAQ from the workbook, not from memory
presentation.summary: Documents an existing Tableau dashboard from its workbook file and a screenshot of the landing view, taking each metric definition from the workbook rather than inferring one.
benefits: Takes metric definitions from the workbook's own definitions field, and stops rather than passing a list of field captions off as documentation
Requires a screenshot of the landing view, because the file does not record what a reader of the FAQ sees
Asks for the refresh schedule instead of inferring one from the extract
Describes only the fields the dashboard actually uses, under the captions readers recognise
Hands back the result as a draft with each definition's source, so the owner reviews the gaps rather than the whole document
